$comment: Generated from linking.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to linking.yaml>`. Do not edit.

GrantCandidate.description: A grant that a grant number may name, as the source that holds it describes it. Where a number names more than one, the researcher chooses; the adviser does not.

id.description: What the grant's record is cited by: its grant DOI as a URL, or its OpenAIRE project page.

award.description: The award number, as the source gives it.

title.description: What a resolved identifier names, as the source gives it: a DOI's title, a person's public name, an organisation's name or a grant's title. Absent for a grant number that names more than one grant.

funder_identifier.description: The funder's identifier as a URL, a Crossref Funder ID or ROR id, where the source gives one.

funding_stream.description: The funder's scheme or programme the grant was made under.

source.description: The source that holds the grant's record (Crossref or OpenAIRE).

GrantCandidate.title: GrantCandidate

GroundingRef.description: The identity and content hash of one retrieved thing a payload rests on. The only way a payload may name an external resource as a decided identity, and the only place it names it: what the reference identifies is read from the evidence item with the same source_id and content_hash (docs/specs/grounding.md). The linter matches every GroundingRef against a retrieval span on both fields.
GroundingRef.title: GroundingRef

RelatedLink.description: One identifier as given, and what the adviser made of it.

scheme.description: The scheme it was recognised as, from schemes.yaml (doi, orcid, ror, grant), or unknown.

normalised.description: The identifier's canonical https form, for a DOI, ORCID iD or ROR id, or a grant number's grant DOI where it names one grant that has one.

relation.description: A suggested DataCite relationType, such as IsSupplementTo, for the researcher to confirm. Absent where the adviser cannot tell.

valid.description: Whether the identifier is well formed for its scheme. True does not mean it exists: only a link with resolved true was looked up.

resolved.description: Whether the identifier (a DOI, ORCID iD, ROR id or grant number) was found through the tool gateway. A grant number is found when it names at least one grant, listed in candidates. Absent when no lookup was made; false when it was made and found nothing or failed, with the reason in message.

title.description: What a resolved identifier names, as the source gives it: a DOI's title, a person's public name, an organisation's name or a grant's title. Absent for a grant number that names more than one grant.

resource_type.description: The type of what a resolved identifier names, as the source gives it: a DOI's resource type, Person for an ORCID iD, an organisation's first ROR type, or Grant for a grant number.

candidates.description: Every grant a resolved grant number may name, for the researcher to choose from where there is more than one.

message.description: What the researcher should check or do with the identifier.

RelatedLink.title: RelatedLink

description: The payload of advisor.linking: each identifier recognised, checked for form and put in canonical form, with a suggested way to record it, what it names where it was resolved, and every grant a grant number may name. It suggests linking metadata for the researcher to review; registering the links stays with the researcher and the repository (R11).

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

summary.description: A short summary of the findings in plain language, for the researcher. It restates the findings and changes none of them.

summary_derivation.description: How the summary came about: template, the rules' own summary, or model, where a model wrote it from the findings.

limitations.description: What the adviser did not do, such as the identifiers it did not resolve.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

title: RelatedIdentifiers
